# Exercise 1

Write a `Makefile` with `all` and `clean` targets for a project where `scrape.py` downloads pages into `data/pages/`, `parse.R` writes `data/listings.csv`, `fit.py` writes `results/fit.json`, and `report.qmd` renders `report.html` from the csv and json. Use command variables, create the output directories, and use a completion marker for the pages. Preserve the downloaded pages when cleaning derived outputs.

```makefile
PY := uv run python
R  := Rscript

.DELETE_ON_ERROR:

all: report.html

report.html: report.qmd data/listings.csv results/fit.json
	quarto render report.qmd

results/fit.json: fit.py data/listings.csv
	mkdir -p "$(@D)"
	$(PY) fit.py

data/listings.csv: parse.R data/pages/.done
	$(R) parse.R

data/pages/.done: scrape.py
	mkdir -p "$(@D)"
	rm -f "$@"
	$(PY) scrape.py
	touch "$@"

clean:
	rm -f data/listings.csv results/fit.json report.html
	rm -rf report_files

.PHONY: all clean
```

Each scenario starts from an up-to-date build. After editing `parse.R`:

```
Rscript parse.R
mkdir -p "results"
uv run python fit.py
quarto render report.qmd
```

After editing `fit.py`:

```
mkdir -p "results"
uv run python fit.py
quarto render report.qmd
```

Deleting one downloaded page does **not** invalidate `data/pages/.done`. The downstream targets will still look current. To refresh the batch explicitly:

```bash
make -B data/pages/.done
make
```

The scraper must return a nonzero exit status on failure. Removing the old marker before starting ensures that a failed refresh is retried next time. For a fixed, known list of pages, tracking individual files can detect missing outputs directly.

`make clean` preserves `data/pages/` and its marker. The next build runs `parse.R`, `fit.py`, and Quarto, without downloading again. `.DELETE_ON_ERROR` removes a tracked target changed by a failing recipe; it does not remove arbitrary side effects.

Useful checks in this exercise directory:

```bash
make
make                 # no recipes should run
make clean
make -j 4            # rebuild derived outputs from saved pages
```

Do not combine `all` and `clean` in a parallel invocation: cleanup can race with the build.
